QUOTE: `PermissionManager::pattern_matches` (`src/mcp/permission_manager.cpp:101`) splits each pattern at the first `:`; table: "`filesystem.read_file` | fnmatch against the tool name | (none) | Every call to that tool, any args"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says patterns are split at the first colon into a tool part (fnmatch against the tool name) and an argument part, and that a pattern with no colon matches every call to that tool, so it matches on the tool name alone.
